name: Free Online Excel Merger - Pure Tools
description: Free online Excel merger: merge multiple .xlsx/.xls into one workbook, keep sheets or merge into a single sheet. Runs locally.
seoDescription: Free online Excel merger to combine multiple Excel files (.xlsx/.xls). Choose to keep each sheet (appended and renamed) or merge all data into a single sheet with source columns. Everything runs locally in your browser with zero uploads for privacy.

ui.hint: Excel Merger: Import multiple Excel files and export a combined workbook (processed locally, no uploads).
ui.dropHint: Click to upload or drag & drop Excel files here; dragging will replace the current file list.
ui.modeKeepSheets: Keep individual sheets (append to new workbook with renamed sheets)
ui.modeSingleSheet: Merge into a single sheet (append rows with source columns)
ui.note: Note: Complex formatting and cross-sheet formulas may not be fully preserved. Please review the output.
